benefit: You slip and slide 35% less.

name: Pitonless Pit Stop
benefit: Hang still on a wall to get 4 stamina back every second.

name: Bing BOING
benefit: Double jump: one extra jump in mid-air, every 35 seconds.

name: Energy Drink Overdose
benefit: You climb 30% faster.

name: Tenderfoot Insurance
benefit: Falls hurt 25% less.

name: Myres' Long Arm
benefit: Grab walls from 20% farther away.

name: Scout Cookie Addiction
benefit: Your stamina bar is 25 longer.

name: Nic of Time
benefit: Once per biome, when your stamina drops below 20, you get 25 back.

name: Hasty Badge Training
benefit: Sprinting tires you 15% less.

name: Scout's Microbreak
benefit: Stamina starts coming back 0.3 seconds sooner.

benefit: Crouch and stay still to get stamina back 35% faster.

name: Myres Made Me Run
benefit: You sprint 25% faster.

name: Endurance Badge Grind
benefit: Climb for 3 seconds straight, and the next second of climbing costs 35% less stamina.

name: Marshmallow Morale
benefit: Every time a campfire is lit, get 15 extra (yellow) stamina.

name: Cool Cucumber Complex
benefit: You heat up 50% slower.

name: Bundled Up Badge
benefit: You get cold 50% slower.

name: Antidote Enthusiast
benefit: Poison builds up 35% slower.

name: ROOTS Survivor
benefit: Spores build up 35% slower.

name: Cactus? What Cactus?
benefit: New thorns count 40% less.
notes: New thorns only; one remaining thorn is rounded up and is not removed.

name: Aloe Aftercare
benefit: Once you're out of the heat, it wears off 60% faster.

name: Heat Pack Afterglow
benefit: Once you're out of the cold, it wears off 60% faster.

name: Fartberry Fitness
benefit: While you have 20+ Poison or Spores, climbing tires you 30% less.
drawback: Poison and Spores wear off 30% slower.

name: BingBong Safety Briefing
benefit: Hits that aren't falls hurt 20% less.

name: Medkit Merit Badge
benefit: Bandages and medkits heal you 25% more.
notes: Item healing only; healing amulet and healing dart are not scaled.

name: Walk It Off, Scout
benefit: While you have 20+ Injury, climbing and sprinting tire you 25% less.

name: Discount Cure-All
benefit: Once per biome, when Poison, Spores or Drowsy reaches 35, 20 of it clears at once.

name: BingBong Flight Insurance
benefit: Once per run, a fall that would knock you out puts you back on safe ground instead.
drawback: You come back with 40 Injury and skip your next card pick.

name: Gourmand's Gut
benefit: Food fills you up 20% more.

name: Book of Broken Bones
benefit: Curse builds up 70% slower.

name: Tenacity Tincture
benefit: Medical items also clear 7.5 of your worst other status.

name: Bing Bong's Baggage
benefit: One extra pocket.
notes: DISABLED: extra pocket is not implemented. If enabled, only the 35% weight penalty works.

name: Carry-On Only
benefit: Everything you carry is 20% lighter.

name: Idol Hands
benefit: The item in your hands weighs 35% less.

name: Cook It, Keep It
benefit: Once per biome, the first cooked food you eat isn't used up.
notes: Preserved food stays in hand; no peel is spawned for the preserved use.

name: Cooking Badge Deluxe
benefit: Cooked food fills you up 50% more.
drawback: Eating uncooked food poisons you a little (+7.5 Poison).

name: Lord of the Spools
benefit: A free rope spool appears for you at each new campfire.

name: Scoutmaster's Care Package
benefit: A free bandage appears for you at each new campfire.

name: Clown Luggage Special
benefit: Get 2 more random cards right now.
drawback: Your third pocket is locked for the rest of the run.
notes: Pocket lock keeps items already in the pocket; it blocks new use of that pocket.

name: Rule Zero
benefit: Near a teammate (6 m), climbing tires you both 15% less.

name: Tara's First Aid Badge
benefit: Healing items you use on teammates heal 60% more.
drawback: Healing items you use on yourself heal 35% less.
notes: Item healing only; healing amulet and healing dart are not scaled.

name: Human Carry-On
benefit: Carrying a scout feels 35% lighter.

name: Happy Camper Huddle
benefit: Huddling warms you 35% more, from 35% farther away.

name: Otto-Matic Clutch
benefit: The first time you revive a teammate in each biome, you both get 20 extra (yellow) stamina.
notes: Book of Bones / Scout Effigy revives are not detected for this reward.

name: Long-Distance Uppies
benefit: Pull teammates up from 30% farther away.

name: Take One for the Troop
benefit: Teammates near you (6 m) take 30% less injury.
drawback: You take half of what you saved them (at most 10 per hit).

name: Friendship Bugle Choir
benefit: Teammates near you (6 m) get stamina back 12% faster.

name: Scout Cannon Legs
benefit: Sprint 35% faster and jump 25% higher.

name: Crown of Bad Decisions
benefit: Get 30 extra (yellow) stamina now, and 20 more at every campfire after.
drawback: Get 10 Curse now, and 5 more at every campfire after.

name: Pandora's Pocket Gamble
benefit: Everything you carry is 10% lighter. In each biome, a 65% chance of 25 extra (yellow) stamina.

name: Bootleg Scoutmaster Bugle
benefit: Once per biome, press B for 60 extra (yellow) stamina.

name: Big Lollipop Crash
benefit: Sprint for 2 seconds and you speed up 30% until you stop.
drawback: Stopping after the speed-up makes you a bit drowsy (+7.5 Drowsy, at most every 30 seconds).

name: Piton Payment Plan
benefit: Falls hurt 15% less, and most of the injury only arrives 20 seconds later.

name: Glass Scout Cannon
benefit: Your stamina bar is 40 longer.

name: Baggage Claim Escapee
benefit: Without a backpack, sprint 30% faster and jump 20% higher.
drawback: With a backpack, you sprint 15% slower.

name: Scout's Dishonor
benefit: Get 1 more random card right now (Common to Rare).
drawback: Get 10 Curse now, and the next campfire offers you only 1 card.

name: BingBong Baggage Scanner
benefit: See food, items and luggage within 12 m, even through rock.
notes: Screen labels through terrain, not object outlines.

name: Medicinal Munchies
benefit: Eating while you have 20+ Injury heals 7.5 Injury.

name: Budget Checkpoint Flag
benefit: Once per biome, press N to set an anchor. If you pass out, you wake up there.

name: Petrify Procrastination
benefit: You turn to stone 35% slower.

name: Myres' Fine Print
benefit: Give up one of your cards: your stamina bar becomes 35 longer.
drawback: Get 5 Curse at every campfire after.

name: Myres' Favorite Scout
benefit: Climbing never tires you, falls never hurt, and you sprint 25% faster.
flavor: The mountain no longer challenges you. It obeys you.

name: The Eternal Campfire
benefit: Everyone within 15 m of you (you too) gets a stamina bar 35 longer and takes 60% less injury and statuses. Once per biome, the first scout nearby who passes out is revived.
flavor: Where you stand, no Scout is left behind.
notes: The revive is for a nearby passed-out scout; host migration does not preserve used revive charges.
